Atlanta, GA @ Mercedes-Benz Stadium12/11/26 - Tampa, FL @ Raymond James StadiumTo connect with USHER:Website(Opens in new tab) Instagram(Opens in new tab) YouTube(Opens in new tab) TikTok(Opens in new tab) Facebook(Opens in new tab) X(Opens in new tab) Spotify(Opens in new tab)To connect with Chris Brown:Website(Opens in new tab) Instagram(Opens in new tab) YouTube(Opens in new tab) Facebook(Opens in new tab) X(Opens in new tab) Spotify(Opens in new tab)FAQSChris Brown and USHER’s co-headlining The R&B Tour will take place over the second half of 2026. The tour is set to begin in June with a show in Denver, followed by stops in cities like Detroit, Nashville, Chicago, Las Vegas, and El Paso. The R&B Tour will wrap in December 2026.Tickets to The R&B Tour will be available via Ticketmaster. You can sign up to join the Artist Presale(Opens in new tab) now through Tuesday, April 21 at 10:00 p.m. ET. You must sign up by April 21 at 10:00 p.m. ET to participate in the Artist Presale. The Artist Presale will take place on Thursday, April 23 at 12:00 p.m. local time.A general ticket sale is scheduled for Monday, April 27 at 12:00 p.m. local time.
